title: HudFabric
description: HudFabric lets you customize your Minecraft HUD with a movable scoreboard, FPS/ping display, custom crosshair, colors, scaling, and quick in-game editing.
body:
# ✨ HudFabric  
✅ Auto Respawn option  
✅ Clean preset button  
✅ Server color toggle  
✅ Vanilla/custom/off modes  
✅ Smooth in-game configuration  
✅ Client-side only setup  

---  

## 🧩 Mod Menu Support  

HudFabric supports **Mod Menu** integration.  

If Mod Menu is installed, you can open the HudFabric config screen directly from the mod list.  

Mod Menu is optional but recommended for the best experience.  

---  

## ✅ Why HudFabric?  

HudFabric is perfect for players who want a cleaner and more customizable Minecraft HUD.  

It is great for:  

⚔️ PvP players  
🎯 Practice players  
🌍 SMP players  
📋 Scoreboard-heavy servers  
🎮 Client-side quality-of-life setups  
✨ Players who like clean interfaces  

No server setup is required.  
Just install the mod on your client and customize your HUD.  

---  

## 📦 Requirements  

HudFabric requires:  

🧵 Fabric Loader  
📚 Fabric API  
☕ Java 21  
🎮 Minecraft Java compatible with 1.21.11-26.1.2  

Optional:  

🧩 Mod Menu  

---  

## 🚀 Summary  

HudFabric gives you a clean, modern, and customizable Minecraft HUD experience.  

Customize your scoreboard.  
Improve your crosshair.  
Show FPS and ping.  
Edit everything in-game.  
Keep your Minecraft interface clean and stylish.  

**A modern HUD editor for Fabric players.**
